title: Distinct mechanisms underlying in-context learning in transformers
abstract: arXiv:2604.12151v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern distributed networks, notably transformers, acquire a remarkable ability (termed `in-context learning') to adapt their computation to input statistics, such that a fixed network can be applied to data from a broad range of systems. Here, we provide a mechanistic characterization of this behavior in transformers trained on a finite set $S$ of discrete Markov chains. The transformer displays four algorithmic phases, characterized by whether the network memorizes or generalizes, and whether it uses 1-point or 2-point statistics. We show that the four phases are implemented by multi-layer subcircuits that exemplify two qualitatively distinct mechanisms for implementing context-adaptive computations. Minimal models isolate the key features of both motifs. Memorization and generalization phases are delineated by two boundaries that depend on data diversity, $K = |S|$. translated_title: Transformer中上下文学习背后的不同机制
translated_abstract: 现代分布式网络，尤其是Transformer，获得了一种卓越的能力（称为“上下文学习”），即能够使其计算适应输入的统计特性，从而使一个固定的网络可以应用于来自广泛系统的数据。在此，我们对在有限离散马尔可夫链集合 $S$ 上训练的Transformer中这种行为提供了机制层面的表征。该Transformer展现出四个算法阶段，其特征取决于网络是进行记忆还是泛化，以及它使用的是单点统计还是双点统计。我们证明这四个阶段由多层子电路实现，这些子电路体现了实现上下文自适应计算的两种性质上截然不同的机制。最小模型分离出了这两种模式的关键特征。记忆阶段和泛化阶段由两条依赖于数据多样性 $K = |S|$ 的边界所划分。第一条边界（$K_1^\ast$）由…之间的动力学竞争所决定…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对有限离散马尔可夫链集合上训练的Transformer进行机制分析，揭示其上下文学习呈现四个算法阶段（记忆或泛化、单点或双点统计），由两种性质截然不同的多层子电路机制实现，并由两条依赖数据多样性的边界划分记忆与泛化阶段。
